name: Lie
overview: Scripture clearly condemns lying as a serious offense against God, declaring that lying lips are an abomination to the LORD while those who speak truth are His delight. The Bible warns that false witnesses and those who speak lies will not go unpunished, emphasizing the temporal nature of lies compared to the enduring nature of truth. Furthermore, John 8:44 identifies the devil as the originator and father of all lies, highlighting the spiritual battle behind deception and the importance of exposing and rejecting falsehood in obedience to God’s commands.
